about.journey: My fascination with computing began when I was twelve, tinkering with ancient hardware and writing my first basic scripts to automate repetitive tasks. What started as a hobby quickly evolved into a lifelong passion for problem-solving and digital craftsmanship. Over the last decade, I've transitioned from building simple landing pages to architecting distributed systems that handle millions of requests.

philosophy.description: Code is read far more often than it is written. I prioritize clarity, consistency, and documentation to ensure longevity.
A fast UI is a respectful UI. I focus on optimizing the critical path and minimizing overhead for the end user.
Technology serves people. I build with empathy and accessibility in mind at every layer of the stack.

timeline.note: Graduated with Honors. Specialized in Distributed Systems and Algorithms.
